metadata.description: Published application image pinned by sha256 digest, including launcher 1.1 or newer.
SSH public key; password authentication is disabled.
Administrator source CIDR for SSH. Do not use an unrestricted internet range.

package_update: true

  - path: /opt/poketracker/backup/status.py
    permissions: '0700'
    encoding: b64
    content: '__BACKUP_FILE_2__'
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/poketracker-backup.service
    permissions: '0644'
    encoding: b64
    content: '__BACKUP_FILE_3__'
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/poketracker-backup.timer
    permissions: '0644'
    encoding: b64
    content: '__BACKUP_FILE_4__'
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/poketracker-verify.service
    permissions: '0644'
    encoding: b64
    content: '__BACKUP_FILE_5__'
  - path: /etc/systemd/system/poketracker-verify.timer
    permissions: '0644'
    encoding: b64
    content: '__BACKUP_FILE_6__'
  - path: /usr/local/sbin/poketracker-bootstrap
    permissions: '0700'
    content: |
      #!/bin/bash
      set -euo pipefail
      image=$(echo '__IMAGE_B64__' | base64 -d)
      domain=$(echo '__DOMAIN_B64__' | base64 -d)
      [[ "$image" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9./_-]+@sha256:[a-f0-9]{64}$ ]] || { echo 'Application image must be pinned by digest'; exit 1; }
      device=/dev/disk/azure/scsi1/lun0
      for attempt in $(seq 1 60); do [ -b "$device" ] && break; sleep 2; done
      [ -b "$device" ] || { echo 'Required managed data disk is missing'; exit 1; }
      if ! blkid "$device" >/dev/null; then
        [ "$(lsblk -nr -o TYPE "$device" | wc -l)" -eq 1 ] || { echo 'Refusing to format a partitioned disk'; exit 1; }
        mkfs.ext4 "$device"
      fi
      [ "$(blkid -s TYPE -o value "$device")" = ext4 ] || { echo 'Expected an ext4 data disk'; exit 1; }
      mkdir -p /srv/poketracker /opt/poketracker
      uuid=$(blkid -s UUID -o value "$device")
      grep -q "UUID=$uuid " /etc/fstab || echo "UUID=$uuid /srv/poketracker ext4 defaults 0 2" >> /etc/fstab
      mountpoint -q /srv/poketracker || mount /srv/poketracker
      mountpoint -q /srv/poketracker
      chmod 0750 /srv/poketracker
      mkdir -p /srv/poketracker/data /srv/poketracker/caddy-data /srv/poketracker/caddy-config
      chown 1000:1000 /srv/poketracker/data
      printf 'POKETRACKER_IMAGE=%s\nDOMAIN=%s\n' "$image" "$domain" > /opt/poketracker/.env
      cat > /opt/poketracker/compose.yaml <<'COMPOSE'
      services:
        poketracker:
          image: ${POKETRACKER_IMAGE:?Set a published image digest}
          restart: unless-stopped
          stop_grace_period: 40s
          environment:
            PUBLIC_URL: https://${DOMAIN}
            TRUST_PROXY: "1"
          volumes:
            - type: bind
              source: /srv/poketracker/data
              target: /data
              bind: {create_host_path: false}
        caddy:
          image: caddy:2-alpine
          restart: unless-stopped
          environment: {DOMAIN: "${DOMAIN}"}
          ports: ["80:80", "443:443"]
          volumes:
            - ./Caddyfile:/etc/caddy/Caddyfile:ro
            - /srv/poketracker/caddy-data:/data
            - /srv/poketracker/caddy-config:/config
      COMPOSE
      printf '{$DOMAIN} {\n reverse_proxy poketracker:3000\n}\n' > /opt/poketracker/Caddyfile
      mkdir -p /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d
      printf '[Unit]\nRequiresMountsFor=/srv/poketracker\n' > /etc/systemd/system/docker.service.d/poketracker-storage.conf
      systemctl daemon-reload
      systemctl enable --now docker
      cd /opt/poketracker
      docker compose pull
      docker compose up -d
runcmd:
  - [/usr/local/sbin/poketracker-bootstrap]
variables.$fxv#1:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
config=${POKETRACKER_BACKUP_CONFIG:-/etc/poketracker-backup.env}
python3 - "$config" <<'PY'
import os, stat, sys
s=os.stat(sys.argv[1])
if s.st_uid != os.geteuid() or stat.S_IMODE(s.st_mode) & 0o077:
    raise SystemExit('Backup configuration must belong to this user and have mode 0600')
PY
set -a
# shellcheck source=/dev/null
source "$config"
set +a
: "${PT_DATA_DIR:?Set the host data directory}"
: "${PT_COMPOSE_FILE:?Set the application compose file}"
: "${PT_BACKUP_ID:?Set a stable instance name}"
: "${RESTIC_REPOSITORY:?Set an independent remote repository}"
: "${RESTIC_PASSWORD_FILE:?Set a host-protected repository password file}"
[[ "$RESTIC_REPOSITORY" == azure:* || "$RESTIC_REPOSITORY" == s3:https://* ]] || { echo 'Use an independent Azure Blob or HTTPS S3 repository' >&2; exit 1; }
[[ "$PT_BACKUP_ID" =~ ^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,64}$ ]] || exit 1
exec 9>"${PT_LOCK_FILE:-/run/lock/poketracker-backup-$PT_BACKUP_ID.lock}"
flock -n 9 || { echo 'Another backup is running' >&2; exit 1; }
status="$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-status.json"
status_helper="$(dirname "$0")/status.py"
trap 'python3 "$status_helper" "$status" backup_failed; echo "Off-host backup failed; the previous recovery point is unchanged" >&2' ERR
snapshot=$(docker compose -f "$PT_COMPOSE_FILE" exec -T poketracker node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning /app/bundle/recovery.mjs snapshot)
name=$(python3 -c 'import json,re,sys; n=json.load(sys.stdin)["name"]; assert re.fullmatch(r"snapshot-\d+-[\w-]+",n); print(n)' <<<"$snapshot")
captured=$(python3 -c 'import json,sys; print(json.load(sys.stdin)["capturedAt"])' <<<"$snapshot")
source_dir="$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-snapshots/$name"
[ -f "$source_dir/manifest.json" ]
docker compose -f "$PT_COMPOSE_FILE" exec -T poketracker node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning /app/bundle/recovery.mjs verify "/data/recovery-snapshots/$name" >/dev/null
restic backup --host "$PT_BACKUP_ID" --tag poketracker "$source_dir"
python3 "$status_helper" "$status" uploaded "$captured"
# Retention deliberately groups by stable instance and tag, not the unique source directory.
restic forget --host "$PT_BACKUP_ID" --tag poketracker --group-by host,tags --keep-hourly 24 --keep-daily 7 --keep-weekly 4 --prune
python3 - "$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-snapshots" <<'PY'
import pathlib,re,shutil,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
snapshots=sorted((p for p in root.iterdir() if p.is_dir() and not p.is_symlink() and re.fullmatch(r'snapshot-\d+-[\w-]+',p.name)),reverse=True)
for old in snapshots[2:]: shutil.rmtree(old)
PY

work=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf -- "$work"' EXIT
status_helper="$(dirname "$0")/status.py"
trap 'python3 "$status_helper" "$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-status.json" verification_failed' ERR
restic check --read-data
python3 "$status_helper" "$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-status.json" checked
id=$(restic snapshots --host "$PT_BACKUP_ID" --tag poketracker --latest 1 --json | python3 -c 'import json,sys; rows=json.load(sys.stdin); assert len(rows)==1; print(rows[0]["id"])')
restic restore "$id" --target "$work" --verify
relative=$(python3 - "$work" <<'PY'
import pathlib,sys
root=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve()
files=list(root.rglob('manifest.json'))
assert len(files)==1, 'Expected exactly one complete application snapshot'
source=files[0].parent.resolve()
assert source.is_relative_to(root)
print(source.relative_to(root))
PY
)
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --entrypoint node -v "$work:/restore:rw" "$PT_IMAGE" --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning /app/bundle/recovery.mjs verify "/restore/$relative"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp --entrypoint node -v "$work:/restore:rw" "$PT_IMAGE" --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning /app/bundle/recovery.mjs restore "/restore/$relative" /restore/rehearsal
python3 "$status_helper" "$PT_DATA_DIR/recovery-status.json" verified

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Atomically merge host backup outcomes without losing concurrent verification updates."""
import datetime
import fcntl
import json
import os
import sys

path, event, *args = sys.argv[1:]
with open(path + '.lock', 'a') as lock:
    fcntl.flock(lock, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
    try:
        if os.stat(path).st_size > 65536:
            raise ValueError('Status exceeds limit')
        with open(path) as stream:
            value = json.load(stream)
        if not isinstance(value, dict):
            value = {}
    except (OSError, ValueError):
        value = {}
    now = datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat()
    if event == 'uploaded':
        captured = args[0]
        datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(captured.replace('Z', '+00:00'))
        value.update(lastSuccessfulCaptureAt=captured, lastUploadedAt=now, lastError=None)
    elif event == 'backup_failed':
        value.update(lastAttemptAt=now, lastError=event)
    elif event == 'checked':
        value.update(lastCheckedAt=now)
    elif event == 'verified':
        value.update(lastCheckedAt=now, lastRestoreVerifiedAt=now, verificationError=None)
    elif event == 'verification_failed':
        value.update(lastVerificationAttemptAt=now, verificationError=event)
    else:
        raise SystemExit('Unsupported status event')
    value['version'] = 1
    temporary = path + '.tmp'
    with open(temporary, 'w') as stream:
        json.dump(value, stream)
        stream.flush()
        os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    os.chmod(temporary, 0o644)
    os.replace(temporary, path)
    parent = os.open(os.path.dirname(path), os.O_RDONLY)
    try:
        os.fsync(parent)
    finally:
        os.close(parent)
